technique_name: Summarize the books of J.R.R. Tolkien.
description: J.R.R. Tolkien's books are often characterized by their vivid and detailed world-building, intricate mythologies, and deep character development. The Lord of the Rings trilogy, considered to be his magnum opus, follows the quest of Frodo Baggins and his fellowship as they attempt to destroy the One Ring and protect Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.
